resources.string: Shake your phone while it lies face-down to flash the time on the Glyph Matrix.
Runs a background service that watches for a shake while the phone is face-down. Keeps a low-priority notification and uses the accelerometer continuously.
Reliable — works on any phone, most battery
Balanced — lighter; needs a wake-up sensor
Lights the four right-hand pixels as a binary counter (top = 8 … bottom = 1, capped at 15). Requires notification access.
Grant notification access to Shake Time, then turn this on.
This launcher does not support pinned shortcuts.
Showing time on the Glyph Matrix

Trigger a reveal from any automation app.

Broadcast (Tasker → Send Intent):
 Action: dev.orsetto.shaketime.action.SHOW_TIME
 Target: Broadcast Receiver

Or launch the activity:
 am start -n dev.orsetto.shaketime/.ShowTimeActivity

Optional long extra "duration_ms" overrides the duration.
